SubscribeFlags.description_en:
Identifies other message types for the subscribed product.

If the subscribed product is a JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway product, the value is:

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

If the subscribed message is the device video stream status change notification, the value is:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    For more information about configuring the Device Video Stream Status Change Notification message for an AMQP server-side subscription, see [AMQP server-side subscription]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2698782.html）.

If both of the preceding messages are subscribed to, the value is:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```
SubscribeFlags.description_zh:
标识当前订阅产品的其他类型消息。

如果订阅的是JT/T 808协议云网关产品，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

如果订阅的是设备视频流状态变更通知消息，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    配置AMQP服务端订阅设备视频流状态变更通知消息的详细内容，请参见[AMQP服务端订阅]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2698782.html）。

如果同时订阅以上消息，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```
